build_video_clip_random_resize_crop: build a VideoClipRandomResizeCrop transform that randomly resizes and crops a video clip tensor for training augmentation
build_video_clip_resize: build a VideoClipResize transform that rescales a video clip tensor to a specified short edge size preserving aspect ratio
build_video_default_augment: build a VideoDefaultAugmentTransform that applies random resize, crop, horizontal flip, and normalization to video data for training
build_video_default_no_augment: build a VideoDefaultNoAugmentTransform that resizes and normalizes video data without augmentation for testing
build_video_field_transform_default: build a video field transform pipeline that maps video and audio tuples to normalized tensors with configurable augmentation
